# Validation Checklist: System Audio Capture Pivot

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for release gates, evidence,
runtime stability, no-hang behavior, and testability before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design
artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are validation evidence requirements complete for idle, active recording, stop, quit, permission matrix, no-HAL, artifact matrix, 30-minute run, and 75-minute run? [Completeness, Contract §Validation Evidence]
- [x] CHK002 Are CPU gate requirements complete for `coreaudiod`, app process, helper processes, memory, settle windows, and sustained-threshold semantics? [Completeness, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are app and meeting responsiveness requirements complete enough to cover UI hangs, meeting freezes, stop availability, and post-stop recovery? [Completeness, Spec §US4]
- [x] CHK004 Are validation requirements complete for HAL driver absent, HAL driver installed but ignored, and no HAL probe executed? [Completeness, Spec §US5, Contract §No-HAL Evidence]
- [x] CHK005 Are toolchain limitation requirements documented for environments where Command Line Tools build but XCTest cannot execute? [Completeness, Quickstart §Swift Build And Tests]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the meaning of "sustained" CPU threshold defined with enough precision for tasks to implement sampling scripts consistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are "blocked", "failed", "degraded", "not-tested", and "accepted" evidence verdicts defined clearly enough to prevent weak evidence from counting as acceptance? [Clarity, Contract §Validation Evidence]
- [x] CHK008 Are validation target requirements clear for Telemost, Chrome, Opera, Zoom/browser-style scopes without expanding support claims beyond accepted evidence? [Clarity, Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [x] CHK009 Are evidence locations and required fields specific enough for review and PR audit? [Clarity, Quickstart §Evidence, Contract §Validation Evidence]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are quickstart commands consistent with planned scripts and contracts, including no-HAL, CPU, artifact, and duration gates? [Consistency, Quickstart §§No-HAL/CPU/Duration, Plan §Source Code]
- [x] CHK011 Are duration gates consistent between spec, plan, quickstart, and validation evidence contract? [Consistency, Spec §SC-008, Quickstart §Duration Gates]
- [x] CHK012 Are validation requirements consistent with the goal of avoiding CoreAudio/HAL probe hangs rather than reproducing them? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Research §CPU And No-HAL Evidence]
- [x] CHK013 Are diagnostic evidence requirements consistent with metadata-only security constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Validation Evidence]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for validation failure handling when CPU gates fail during idle, active recording, stop, or quit? [Coverage, Data Model §CaptureHealthSnapshot]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for validation runs where one track is degraded but app responsiveness and CPU gates pass? [Coverage, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for validation runs where permissions change during recording? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for long-duration validation evidence that includes artifact continuity and not just live audibility? [Coverage, Contract §Duration Evidence]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Are all P1 success criteria objectively measurable without relying on user impression alone? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK019 Are validation requirements strict enough that short smoke behavior cannot be counted as release acceptance? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK020 Are review requirements traceable from validation evidence fields back to specific success criteria and contracts? [Traceability, Contract §Validation Evidence]
